lines.text: Israel says many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
Israel says the plowmen plowed over my back and made their furrows long.
Israel says the LORD is righteous and has cut me from the cords of the proud.
The psalm wishes all who hate Babylon be turned back in shame, like grass on the rooftops.
The psalm wishes none who pass by would say to them, "The blessing of the LORD be on you."
